dct_creator_sm: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development.
dct_description_sm: A  three-year survey of the knowledge and skills of 15-year-olds in the principal industrialised countries.   The survey, conducted first in 2000, will be repeated every three years.  265,000 students from 32 countries took part.  Students sat pencil and paper assessments in their schools.  Students and their principals also answered questionnaires about themselves and their schools. This allowed PISA to identify what factors are associated with better and worse performance.    There is also an interactive data selection tool for PISA 2000 data at the Australian Council for Educational Research.
